End-2022 diagonal minus end-2021 diagonal, underwriting years up to 2020: 2013 625.9-628.9 = -3.0; 2014 679.5-692.1 = -12.6; 2015 654.5-663.4 = -8.9; 2016 704.6-702.6 = +2.0; 2017 1,010.3-1,016.9 = -6.6; 2018 928.0-862.2 = +65.8; 2019 835.9-793.8 = +42.1; 2020 898.7-846.2 = +52.5; total +131.3.
